scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate:local && npm run frontend:build && wrangler dev --port 8787 --var ENABLE_DEBUG_INSPECTION:true
scripts.frontend:build: npm run sdk:build && npm run lab:build
scripts.frontend:check: npm run frontend:build && node --check public/sdk/splitnext-client.js && node --check public/sdk/splitnext-lab.js && node --check public/dashboard/app.js
scripts.check: npm run types:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run frontend:check && npm test && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run
